title: watch_access_get
description: A phone asks for the current Home Assistant access of the watch it set up (watchos, wearos). A watch never has a hub socket of its own; its phone carries the access, sealed to the watch's key, so the phone cannot read it. Only on an authenticated socket of the device that set the watch up (set_up_by, method onboard). Answer: watch_access (status ready, pending or gone).
